# avd_current_state_drift.ps1

<!-- Generated by scripts/Update-BrainDocs.ps1 from the code. Do not edit; edit the code and regenerate. -->

AVD Current State Drift -- compares a live landing zone with what avd-landing-zone last deployed, attributes every change, and reports it.

Personal project, not for production use. Provided as is, without warranty of any kind (MIT License, see LICENSE). Not affiliated with the author's employer, with Liquidware or with Microsoft. Design: docs/drift-spec.md. One run: 1. Health check: an Az context, the reads it needs, and (in GitHub Actions) a private repository. 2. Reads, through Resource Graph and REST GETs only: the subscription's deployment records, the collector's rebuild scope (rebuild/scope.json), the Resource Graph change log (14 days) and the Activity Log for the types the change log doesn't cover. 3. Compares the deployment's parameters with the landing zone host pool's rebuild map. 4. Attributes each change: a landing zone deployment (by correlation ID), the landing zone's own automation (drift/expected-actors.json), run-time state (drift/runtime-paths.json), or unexplained. A rule hides changes only while its exact digest is approved (section 3.6). 5. Writes drift-report.md, drift-results.json and manifest.json to -OutputPath and exits 2 (couldn't check), 1 (findings) or 0 (clean). Only 0 may close the drift issue. Fixes never come from here: they go through the landing zone's deploy workflow after a person approves (section 3.4). The report holds names and values and belongs in a private place.

## Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `-SubscriptionId` | string | no |  | The landing zone's subscription. Defaults to the current Az context's. |
| `-Environment` | string | no |  | The landing zone environment (dev, test, prod), when the subscription holds more than one. |
| `-DeploymentName` | string | no |  | A specific subscription deployment to treat as the declared state, instead of the latest avdlz-* one. |
| `-BaselinePath` | string | no |  | A committed baseline (avd-current-state-drift-baseline/v1) to use as the declared state for an estate the landing zone didn't deploy, or when the deployment records can't be read. |
| `-ProposeBaseline` | switch | no |  | Writes drift-baseline.proposed.json for each host pool (every found or derived value) for a person to review and commit, then exits. Compares nothing. |
| `-ConfigPath` | string | no |  | The operator's private folder with drift-exceptions.json, drift-approvals.json and drift-values.json. Missing files count as empty: with no approvals, no rule hides anything. |
| `-OutputPath` | string | no | `(Join-Path (Get-Location).Path 'output')` |  |
| `-LastSuccess` | string | no |  | When the last successful run finished (the workflow reads it from its run history). Older than 14 days is reported as a window gap and the Activity Log covers the span back to it, up to 90 days. |
| `-Digest` | switch | no |  | Adds the weekly digest of suppression rules to the report. |
| `-DigestThreshold` | int | no | `50` |  |
| `-ShowSuppressionDigest` | switch | no |  | Prints each rule's digest, its approval state and a ready-to-paste approval line, then exits. Offline. |

## Examples

```powershell
pwsh -NoLogo -File ./avd_current_state_drift.ps1 -Environment dev -ConfigPath ~/avd-private/drift
```
```powershell
pwsh -NoLogo -File ./avd_current_state_drift.ps1 -ConfigPath ~/avd-private/drift -ShowSuppressionDigest
```
